info.title: BigBooks API
info.description: All endpoints require a bearer JWT issued by the BigBooks authorization server. Many endpoints additionally take an X-Acting-Party-ID header selecting the tenant party being acted for. Mutations of versioned resources require an If-Match header echoing the ETag from the resource's GET. List endpoints paginate with page_size and page_number (zero-based). Full conventions and a domain glossary: https://api.bigbooks.app/docs/integrator-guide.md
